result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. The change compiles, but I didn't run any tests.

In `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, the remainder branch now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

Configured teams still get all their matching members. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for a blank date, so I didn't need to handle that case.
